subject.title: Bonsall Unified School District Board, Trustee Area B

text: My name is Michael Gaddis. Living in Bonsall with my wife, our two children, both of whom attended Bonsall schools, and our little dog Charlie keeps me grounded in the community I have lived in for 17 years. Although I am an attorney and businessman, I have always been an academic at heart and believe strongly in the value of education. My time as Trustee has provided me with a deeper understanding of both the challenges and opportunities facing our district. I have learned that the most important thing to being a Trustee is listening. Everyone should have the opportunity to express concerns, offer ideas, and question the status quo. That is how we create accountability and continue to grow as a district. Today’s students are tomorrow’s leaders. Trustees have the responsibility of shaping and protecting the educational future of our students. I take that responsibility seriously. When I was young, my family did not have a lot, but the schools I attended provided me with stability and hope. I am running for re-election because I want every Bonsall student to believe that with hard work, determination, guidance, and a community willing to invest in them, anything is possible.
